facts.fact: Togo had 12.55 million e-money accounts, 6.07 million active (48.35%), at the end of 2024, with over 81,000 service points and nearly 5,800 merchants accepting e-payments, per the BCEAO report cited by Togo First.
PI-SPI is said to allow real-time transactions between banks, mobile money operators and financial institutions in Togo, though its adoption remains very gradual, per Togo First.
